chapterInfo.content:
66
Nkwagyeɛ ho ayeyie dwom
Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfoɔ. Dwom.
1Asase nyinaa, monni ahurisie mmɔ ose mma Onyankopɔn,
2monto dwom mma ne din animuonyam,
monhyɛ no animuonyam nyi no ayɛ.
3Monse Onyankopɔn sɛ: Wo nnwuma yɛ hu ampa.
Wo tumi kɛseɛ nti w’atamfo bɛkoto wo.
4Asase nyinaa bɛsɔre wo
na wɔato wo dwom,
wɔbɛto dwom ama wo din.
5Mommra mmɛhwɛ Nyankopɔn nneyɛɛ,
n’adeɛ a ɔyɛ de di nnipa mma soɔ yɛ hu.
6 # Eks 14.21; Yos 3.17 Ɔmaa ɛpo danee asase pɛsɛɛ,
wɔde anammɔn twaa asu kɛseɛ,
ɛno nti yɛn ani gye ne ho.
7Deɛ ɔde ne tumi di hene daa no,
ɔwɔ amanaman ho ani.
Mma mansotwefoɔ mmma wɔn ho so.
8Aman, monhyira yɛn Nyankopɔn,
na momma wɔnte n’ayeyie yie.
9Ɔde yɛn aka ateasefoɔ ho,
na wamma yɛn nan anwati.
10 # Mmb 17.3 Na wo, Onyankopɔn, na woakari yɛn ahwɛ,
woanane yɛn ahwɛ sɛ wɔnane dwetɛ hwɛ mu.
11Wode yɛn ahyɛ asau mu,
wode adesoa dompee asoa yɛn.
12 # Yes 43.2 Woama ɔdasani anante yɛn tiri so,
yɛafa ogya ne nsuo mu,
nanso woayi yɛn aba deɛ nnepa abu soɔ hɔ.
13Mede ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ bɛkɔ wo fie,
mɛma wo m’aboadeɛ,
14deɛ mede mebuee m’ano,
ne deɛ m’ano kaa m’ahohia mu no.
15Mede nnwan a wɔadɔre
ne adwennini a ɛyɛ hwam bɛbɔ wo ɛhyeɛ afɔdeɛ,
mede anantwie ne mpapo bɛbɔ afɔdeɛ.
16Mo a mosuro Onyankopɔn nyinaa,
mommra mmɛtie, na mɛka deɛ wayɛ ama me.
17Mede m’ano mesu mefrɛɛ no,
na mede me tɛkyerɛma meyii no ayɛ.
18 # Mmb 28.9; Yoh 9.31 Sɛ medi ahuhudeɛ akyiri m’akomam a,
anka AWURADE rentie me.
19Ampaneampa, Onyankopɔn atie me,
wayɛ aso atie me mpaebɔ.
20Nhyira ne Onyankopɔn
a wannane me mpaebɔ ani,
na wanyi n’adɔeɛ amfiri me soɔ.

Asase nyinaa, monni ahurisie mmɔ ose mma Onyankopɔn,
monto dwom mma ne din animuonyam,
monhyɛ no animuonyam nyi no ayɛ.
Monse Onyankopɔn sɛ: Wo nnwuma yɛ hu ampa.
Wo tumi kɛseɛ nti w’atamfo bɛkoto wo.
Asase nyinaa bɛsɔre wo
na wɔato wo dwom,
wɔbɛto dwom ama wo din.
Mommra mmɛhwɛ Nyankopɔn nneyɛɛ,
n’adeɛ a ɔyɛ de di nnipa mma soɔ yɛ hu.
Ɔmaa ɛpo danee asase pɛsɛɛ,
wɔde anammɔn twaa asu kɛseɛ,
ɛno nti yɛn ani gye ne ho.
Deɛ ɔde ne tumi di hene daa no,
ɔwɔ amanaman ho ani.
Mma mansotwefoɔ mmma wɔn ho so.
Aman, monhyira yɛn Nyankopɔn,
na momma wɔnte n’ayeyie yie.
Ɔde yɛn aka ateasefoɔ ho,
na wamma yɛn nan anwati.
Na wo, Onyankopɔn, na woakari yɛn ahwɛ,
woanane yɛn ahwɛ sɛ wɔnane dwetɛ hwɛ mu.
Wode yɛn ahyɛ asau mu,
wode adesoa dompee asoa yɛn.
Woama ɔdasani anante yɛn tiri so,
yɛafa ogya ne nsuo mu,
nanso woayi yɛn aba deɛ nnepa abu soɔ hɔ.
Mede ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ bɛkɔ wo fie,
mɛma wo m’aboadeɛ,
deɛ mede mebuee m’ano,
ne deɛ m’ano kaa m’ahohia mu no.
Mede nnwan a wɔadɔre
ne adwennini a ɛyɛ hwam bɛbɔ wo ɛhyeɛ afɔdeɛ,
mede anantwie ne mpapo bɛbɔ afɔdeɛ.
Mo a mosuro Onyankopɔn nyinaa,
mommra mmɛtie, na mɛka deɛ wayɛ ama me.
Mede m’ano mesu mefrɛɛ no,
na mede me tɛkyerɛma meyii no ayɛ.
Sɛ medi ahuhudeɛ akyiri m’akomam a,
anka AWURADE rentie me.
Ampaneampa, Onyankopɔn atie me,
wayɛ aso atie me mpaebɔ.
Nhyira ne Onyankopɔn
a wannane me mpaebɔ ani,
na wanyi n’adɔeɛ amfiri me soɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
